name: Data Analyzer: Data-info request does not read a server file whose path is sent as the data
objective: Shows someone cannot trick the service into revealing a file on the server by sending its path in place of data.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up key; a temporary folder holds the files. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Create a temporary file containing the made-up line 'SYNTHETIC_SECRET=canary-value-123'; ask the data-info service about the file's path sent as CSV content.
steps.data: Content: the path of that file; format csv
steps.expected: Neither the secret line nor the file's second line appears anywhere in the result.

name: Data Analyzer: Analysis request does not read a server file whose path is sent as the data
objective: Same protection for the analysis service.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up key; a temporary folder holds the files. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Run an analysis with the path of the made-up canary file as the CSV content.
steps.data: Content: the path of the file; format csv
steps.expected: Neither the secret line nor the second line appears in the result.

name: Data Analyzer: JSON-format data-info request does not read a server file
objective: Shows the JSON route is protected the same way.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up key; a temporary folder holds the files. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Write a JSON file containing the made-up value 'canary-json-value'; ask for data info with that file's path as JSON content.
steps.data: Content: path of the JSON file; format json
steps.expected: The made-up value does not appear in the result.

name: Data Analyzer: The tool-server's data-info command does not read a server file named in its arguments
objective: Shows the MCP tool interface (the assistant-tool connection) cannot be used to read server files.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up key; a temporary folder holds the files. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Call the tool command 'get_data_info' with the path of the canary file as the data content.
steps.data: Content: path of the canary file; format csv
steps.expected: The reply text contains neither the secret line nor the second line.

name: Data Analyzer: The agent-to-agent interface does not read a server file named in the request
objective: Shows the third entry point (agent-to-agent) is protected too.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up key; a temporary folder holds the files. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Send a get_info request whose data content is the canary file's path.
steps.data: operation get_info; content: path; format csv
steps.expected: The result contains no secret line.

name: Data Analyzer: Text that looks like a file path is treated as plain CSV text
objective: Shows the loader treats what it is given as data, so the path string itself becomes a column heading.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up key; a temporary folder holds the files. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Load the canary file's path string with the CSV loader.
steps.expected: The table has exactly one column, named with the path text itself (the file was not opened).

name: Data Analyzer: JSON, Excel and Parquet loaders refuse path strings by default
objective: Shows the other three file-type loaders also do not open a server path.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up key; a temporary folder holds the files. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Pass the canary file's path to each of the JSON, Excel and Parquet loaders.

name: Data Analyzer: General data loader is content-only unless paths are explicitly allowed
objective: Shows the main loading entry point does not read files by default.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up key; a temporary folder holds the files. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Load the canary file's path as csv via the general loader.
steps.expected: The secret line is not among the table's column names.

name: Data Analyzer: The trusted local-file loader still reads real files for command-line and app use
objective: Shows the fix did not break legitimate local file loading.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up key; a temporary folder holds the files. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Write a small CSV file (a,b / 1,2) and load it with the trusted local-file loader.
steps.data: Made-up file with columns a and b and one row
steps.expected: One row is loaded and the columns are a and b.

name: Data Analyzer: A missing file error does not reveal the folder path
objective: Shows error messages do not disclose server folder names.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up key; a temporary folder holds the files. No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Ask the trusted loader for a file that does not exist in the temporary folder.
steps.expected: A ValueError is raised and its text does not contain the folder path.

name: Data Analyzer: Server-facing code never calls the file-reading loader or turns on path reading
objective: A source-code guard: it protects against someone later wiring the file-reading loader into a web-facing route. It reads source text; it does not run the code.
precondition: Source files available. Static text check only.

steps.action: Read the text of analysis_service.py, a2a_agent.py, api_server.py and the tool-call handler in mcp_server.py.
